data.long_meaning: Ansya is derived from the Sanskrit word 'ansa', meaning 'graceful' or 'delightful'. In Hindu mythology, Ansya is a divine name associated with the goddess Lakshmi, symbolizing beauty, prosperity, and good fortune. The name Ansya carries the meaning “Graceful, Delightful” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Sanskrit tradition and is also used in Hindi, Sanskrit, Marathi. Parents who choose Ansya usually hope their child will grow to embody graceful, delightful and live with faith, good character and purpose.

historical_references.reference: Ansya or Anshu is an alternate name for the Hindu god of the sun, Surya. The name Anshu means 'setting sun' in Sanskrit.

historical_references.reference: Anshu or Ansya was also the name of a powerful and wealthy merchant king in medieval India (circa 13th-15th centuries). He was a prominent figure in Gujarat and is known for his philanthropy and social contributions.
